say:1:1721930001:1.text: Three trinkets filled with happy memories... I don't even know if I have any happy memories at all.
say:1:1721930001:1.source_cn: 唉，三颗凝结了快乐回忆的珠子……我的生活里早就没有快乐...
say:1:1721930001:1.male: Three trinkets filled with happy memories... I don't even know if I have any happy memories at all.
say:1:1721930001:1.female: Three trinkets filled with happy memories... I don't even know if I have any happy memories at all.

say:2:1721930002:1.text: Every day I wake up to the same bare room and the same people looking down on me. There's not much happiness in that...
say:2:1721930002:1.source_cn: 每天一睁开眼就是家徒四壁和别人的冷眼，哪里还有什么快乐...
say:2:1721930002:1.male: Every day I wake up to the same bare room and the same people looking down on me. There's not much happiness in that...
say:2:1721930002:1.female: Every day I wake up to the same bare room and the same people looking down on me. There's not much happiness in that...

say:3:1721930003:1.text: And now she wants me to play something cheerful... but these days, all I seem able to play are sad songs.
say:3:1721930003:1.source_cn: 茜茜夫人还让我弹唱快乐的曲子，可是我的琴弦已经只能弹出...
say:3:1721930003:1.male: And now she wants me to play something cheerful... but these days, all I seem able to play are sad songs.
say:3:1721930003:1.female: And now she wants me to play something cheerful... but these days, all I seem able to play are sad songs.

say:5:1721930004:1.text: ... Alright. I'm not hopeful, but for Miss Pearl, I'll try.
say:5:1721930004:1.source_cn: ……好吧，虽然我不抱什么希望，但为了珍珠小姐，我愿意试试。
say:5:1721930004:1.male: ... Alright. I'm not hopeful, but for Miss Pearl, I'll try.

choice:4:0:1.text: We're running out of time. We need to get the gift ready.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 时间不多了，该采买见面礼了

choice:4:1:2.text: Let's take a walk. Something might jog your memory.
